items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: We’re going to be doing music from Simone to my compositions

ctx.x: It’s going to be a great time. We’re going to be doing music from Simone to my compositions to Second Line, you know, again reaching forward and reaching back so the techniques that I need to play a Simone type tune or a Charles Tollver “Ruthie’s © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-
Heart” type tune, and also the techniques going backwards and playing a second line type presentation.
